dataset_name: Official Statistical Cadres Grounded Question Bank

questions.question_text: According to National Accounts Statistics: Sources and Methods (CSO, 2012), what foundational function do the national accounts provide for an economy?

options.A: A regulatory mechanism for approving commercial banking licenses
options.B: A comprehensive, conceptual and accounting framework for analyzing and evaluating economic performance
options.C: A statutory audit standard strictly for state-level cooperative societies
options.D: A predictive algorithmic trading index for public sector stock exchanges

questions.explanation: Chapter 1 (Paragraph 1.1) specifies that the national accounts provide a comprehensive, conceptual and accounting framework for analyzing and evaluating the performance of an economy.
questions.source_excerpt: The national accounts provide a comprehensive, conceptual and accounting framework for analyzing and evaluating the performance of an economy.

questions.question_text: In the compilation of Indian National Accounts, which primary survey provides the annual product- and industry-level data on output for the registered manufacturing sector?

options.A: Annual Survey of Industries (ASI)
options.B: Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS)
options.C: Wholesale Price Index Quarterly Digest
options.D: Comprehensive Agricultural Census Ledger

questions.explanation: Chapter 1 (Paragraph 1.78/1.80, Page 19) states that detailed annual data on output according to products and industries is available from the Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) every year.
questions.source_excerpt: on output according to products and industries is available from the Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) every year.

questions.question_text: Under the 1993 System of National Accounts (SNA) adopted in the NAS revisions, which asset category covering expenditures on precious items was formally incorporated into gross capital formation?

options.A: Derivatives
options.B: Valuables
options.C: Contingent Liabilities
options.D: Unrealized Goodwill

questions.explanation: Chapter 1 (Page 20) states: 'Besides the above, valuables which covers the expenditures made on acquisition of valuables, has been included in accordance with the recommendations of 1993 SNA.'
questions.source_excerpt: Besides the above, 'valuables' which covers the expenditures made on acquisition of valuables, has been included in accordance with the recommendations of 1993 SNA.

questions.question_text: How is the publication 'National Accounts Statistics: Sources and Methods (2012)' structured across parts and chapters?

options.A: Three parts covering 12 chapters
options.B: Five parts covering 35 chapters
options.C: Eight parts covering 50 chapters
options.D: Two volumes covering 18 chapters

questions.explanation: The Introduction (Page 3) explicitly affirms that the publication is organized in five parts covering 35 Chapters.
questions.source_excerpt: The publication is organized in five parts covering 35 Chapters.

questions.question_text: In the estimation of agricultural output and by-products in the NAS series, which authoritative institutional source provides the latest cost of cultivation data?

options.A: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Ministry of Agriculture (DESAg)
options.B: Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Committee
options.C: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
options.D: Food Corporation of India Procurement Board

questions.explanation: Chapter 1 (Paragraph 1.25, Page 11) specifies: 'the latest data on cost of cultivation studies available from the DESAg, has been used in the new series.'
questions.source_excerpt: the latest data on cost of cultivation studies available from the DESAg, has been used in the new series.

questions.question_text: Under the Karmayogi Competency Model (KCM), what is the core capability defined for the Project Management functional competency?

options.A: Demonstrating the ability to plan phases, identify key activities, dependencies, and milestones for driving public projects
options.B: Authorizing international financial trade disbursements without departmental review
options.C: Conducting statutory criminal litigation on behalf of ministerial commissions
options.D: Drafting bilateral defense procurement treaties

questions.explanation: KCM Definition (Page 74) states that Project Management encompasses the ability to plan phases/stages, identify key activities, dependencies, and milestones, and create standard frameworks for project delivery.
questions.source_excerpt: Demonstrates ability to plan phases/stages and identify key activities, dependencies, and milestones for driving projects.

questions.question_text: In public sector project risk management as defined in KCM, how should project dependencies and milestones be managed across government agencies?

options.A: By ignoring inter-ministerial constraints until the final launch deadline
options.B: By establishing formal dependency tracking frameworks and clear milestone reviews
options.C: By delegating all monitoring obligations to external non-governmental contractors
options.D: By altering project scope whenever a sub-task exceeds schedule without documentation

questions.explanation: KCM Project Management behavioral indicators (Page 75) emphasize utilizing standard frameworks to determine project scope, dependencies, and structured milestone tracking.
questions.source_excerpt: Utilizes & creates various standard framework / mechanisms to determine project scope and tracking.

questions.question_text: At an advanced proficiency level (Level 4/5) in public project execution, what role does stakeholder alignment play?

options.A: It is restricted purely to annual departmental press releases
options.B: Proactively orchestrating cross-functional governance structures and risk mitigation strategies across participating ministries
options.C: Eliminating all internal reporting in favor of informal meetings
options.D: Transferring project risk exclusively to end beneficiaries

questions.explanation: KCM Level 4/5 descriptors for Project Management emphasize driving cross-functional governance mechanisms and institutional risk mitigation.
questions.source_excerpt: orchestrating cross-functional governance and structured milestone management

questions.question_text: How does the Karmayogi Competency Model define the behavioral competency 'Collaboration'?

options.A: Solely executing isolated directives without sharing working files with peers
options.B: Working in tandem with others as an integral unit, establishing partnerships and cooperative working relationships toward organizational goals
options.C: Imposing unilateral hierarchy over peer divisions to prevent consensus
options.D: Outsourcing internal teamwork to independent external consultancies

questions.explanation: KCM Collaboration Definition (Page 49) defines collaboration as working in tandem with others as an integral unit and establishing cooperative working relationships.
questions.source_excerpt: Working in tandem with others as an integral unit, establishing partnerships and cooperative working relationships toward realizing Division / Department / Ministry goals.

questions.question_text: What is a primary behavioral indicator of collaborative practice among statistical and administrative officers?

options.A: Withholding interim data releases from research divisions
options.B: Proactively sharing relevant knowledge and facilitating constructive cross-divisional dialogue
options.C: Refusing feedback during inter-cadre coordination meetings
options.D: Restricting communications strictly to formal gazette notifications

questions.explanation: KCM Behavioral Indicators (Page 50) specify that officers actively share data resources and foster cross-functional synergy across administrative divisions.
questions.source_excerpt: Proactively sharing relevant information and resources with team members across divisions.

questions.question_text: At an advanced leadership level, how does an officer manifest strategic collaboration during institutional disputes?

options.A: Escalating grievances directly to external media outlets
options.B: Mediating differing departmental perspectives to align stakeholders around overarching public interest outcomes
options.C: Suspending inter-agency consultations indefinitely
options.D: Withdrawing assigned cadre resources from collaborative taskforces

questions.explanation: KCM Advanced Collaboration Indicators (Page 50) highlight mediating institutional conflicts and uniting diverse stakeholders behind national statistical objectives.
questions.source_excerpt: building consensus and resolving divergent viewpoints for shared goals

questions.question_text: What core characteristic distinguishes Strategic Leadership under Mission Karmayogi guidelines?

options.A: Micro-managing daily clerical attendance logs
options.B: Ability to foresee future challenges, discern operating environments holistically, and steer long-term institutional directions
options.C: Limiting organizational planning strictly to the current budgetary quarter
options.D: Delegating all strategic decision-making to international advisory bodies

questions.explanation: KCM Strategic Leadership definition (Page 57) focuses on foreseeing future challenges and opportunities by discerning operating environments holistically.
questions.source_excerpt: Ability to foresee future challenges and identify opportunities by discerning the operating environment holistically and being cognizant of emerging dynamics.

questions.question_text: When formulating national statistical policy in dynamic environments, how does a strategic leader balance short-term and long-term priorities?

options.A: By subordinating all data quality checks to short-term political convenience
options.B: By aligning immediate survey operations with enduring statistical integrity and national modernization roadmap objectives
options.C: By freezing technological modernization to preserve legacy manual spreadsheets
options.D: By bypassing National Statistical Commission governance reviews

questions.explanation: KCM Strategic Leadership indicators (Page 58) highlight steering near-term operations in alignment with long-term institutional mission and modernization roadmaps.
questions.source_excerpt: aligns operational actions with long-term strategic vision and mandate

questions.question_text: At the strategic expert level (Level 5), what standard characterizes transformative leadership in civil service capacity building?

options.A: Institutionalizing adaptive learning systems and creating an ecosystem of continuous competency improvement across subordinate cadres
options.B: Abolishing competitive examinations and competency assessments
options.C: Restricting capacity development programs solely to senior joint secretaries
options.D: Discouraging cross-cadre analytical specialization

questions.explanation: KCM Level 5 indicators for leadership emphasize fostering institutional capacity, adaptive learning culture, and systemic capability building.
questions.source_excerpt: creating an ecosystem of continuous learning and developing future cadre leaders

questions.question_text: According to the source documentation (Page 1), which of the following is correct regarding 'National Statistical'?

options.A: The principle is strictly discretionary and not applied to standard statistical procedures.
options.B: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Greater Noida is the premier apex training institute under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
options.C: It was deprecated following the implementation of state-level decentralized accounting frameworks.
options.D: The methodology is confined exclusively to commercial export licensing and speculative valuation.

questions.explanation: Official publication (Page 1) explicitly states: 'National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Greater Noida is the premier apex training institute under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI).'.
questions.source_excerpt: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), Greater Noida is the premier apex training institute under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI).

questions.question_text: Under the Karmayogi Competency Model (KCM), what does the 'Active Listening' sub-theme emphasize in official communication?

options.A: Recording conversations covertly without stakeholder knowledge
options.B: Paying close attention to spoken communication, interpreting intent from verbal and non-verbal cues, and responding respectfully
options.C: Immediately interrupting speakers to correct administrative terminology
options.D: Relying exclusively on written circulars and avoiding interpersonal dialogues

questions.explanation: KCM Communication guidelines (Pages 45-46) define Active Listening as demonstrating the capacity to pay close attention to what is being said and to interpret the spirit and intent from non-verbal cues.
questions.source_excerpt: Demonstrates the capacity to pay close attention to what is being said and to interpret the spirit and intent of the speaker from other cues such as body language and facial expressions.

questions.question_text: In official civil service reporting, which presentation practice best aligns with KCM standards for conveying statistical inspection findings?

options.A: Presenting raw unstructured data tables without executive summaries or analytical highlights
options.B: Highlighting key findings, methodology, accomplishments, and operational difficulties with clarity tailored to the audience
options.C: Omitting survey limitations to present an artificially flawless operational picture
options.D: Using informal colloquialisms in statutory cadre briefings

questions.explanation: KCM Presentation Skills sub-theme (Page 46) emphasizes creating documents and briefings that highlight key points, accomplishments, and difficulties with conviction and rationality.
questions.source_excerpt: Displays the ability to create documents and presentations that highlight the key points, details, accomplishments, and difficulties associated with the topic at hand.

questions.question_text: How does an officer operating at an advanced communication level handle contentious inter-departmental viewpoints?

options.A: Dismisses dissenting perspectives through unilateral administrative orders
options.B: Integrates diverse viewpoints with rationality, responds with humility and clarity, and builds consensus
options.C: Refers every routine operational query to external appellate bodies
options.D: Suspends communications until ministerial leadership intervenes

questions.explanation: KCM Level 4/5 Communication indicators highlight presenting information with conviction, persuasion, and humility while reconciling diverse perspectives.
questions.source_excerpt: Presents information with conviction, fluency, rationality, and persuasion while using communication techniques tailored to the audience.

questions.question_text: In handling government administration matters under KCM-FUNC-21, what statutory requirement governs official communication in Hindi across central government offices?

options.A: General Financial Rules, 2017
options.B: Official Languages Act, 1963
options.C: Right to Information Act, 2005
options.D: Central Civil Services Conduct Rules, 1964

questions.explanation: KCM Administration Matters (Page 107) explicitly cites carrying out official communication in accordance with the Official Languages Act, 1963 in Hindi.
questions.source_excerpt: Carries out all official communication within central and state government offices in accordance with the Official Languages Act, 1963, in Hindi.

questions.question_text: What is the primary responsibility of a Section Officer when processing Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and daily travel claims under KCM-FUNC-21?

options.A: Approving claims unconditionally without verifying tour orders or fare receipts
options.B: Applying relevant rules, circulars, and entitlements for accurate verification and timely settlement of travel claims
options.C: Arbitrarily deducting 50% from all submitted bills to reduce section expenditure
options.D: Delegating claim verification entirely to external contractual vendors

questions.explanation: KCM Administration Matters (Page 106) specifies applying relevant rules, regulations, and guidelines for processing Leave and Travel matters.
questions.source_excerpt: Demonstrates understanding and ability to apply the relevant rules, regulations and guidelines for processing of Leave and Travel related matters in the Ministry.

questions.question_text: How does an administrative section supervisor ensure institutional compliance with allowances and miscellaneous entitlements?

options.A: Relying on informal unwritten precedents rather than Department of Expenditure OMs
options.B: Synthesizing extant OM provisions, verifying entitlement conditions, and eliminating audit discrepancies in section records
options.C: Delaying processing of allowances until the final week of the financial year
options.D: Exempting supervisory staff from standard reimbursement documentation

questions.explanation: KCM Allowances & Reimbursements sub-theme (Page 106) emphasizes thorough adherence to guidelines and regulatory provisions to ensure institutional consistency.
questions.source_excerpt: Demonstrates understanding and ability to apply the relevant rules, regulations and guidelines for processing of Allowances and Reimbursements related matters.

questions.question_text: According to the Karmayogi Competency Model (KCM-BEH-02), what defines personal effectiveness under demanding survey schedules?

options.A: Working continuously without rest while ignoring operational errors
options.B: Managing time and workplace stress effectively while upholding ethical integrity and focus on quality delivery
options.C: Refusing field postings that involve tight statutory deadlines
options.D: Passing all accountability for delayed survey schedules to subordinate staff

questions.explanation: KCM Personal Effectiveness (Pages 41-42) focuses on self-management, maintaining composure under pressure, and ethical dedication to duty.
questions.source_excerpt: Demonstrates resilience, personal integrity, and the ability to maintain composure and performance when faced with workplace pressures.

questions.question_text: When statistical field operations encounter unforeseen sampling anomalies or weather disruptions, how does an effective officer respond?

options.A: Cancels the entire round without consulting supervisory authorities
options.B: Demonstrates adaptability, formulates contingency field schedules, and maintains survey rigour
options.C: Substitutes arbitrary synthetic figures for uncollected field samples
options.D: Waits passively until formal gazette directives are issued

questions.explanation: KCM Adaptability and Resilience indicators highlight finding proactive, sound solutions while preserving methodological standards.
questions.source_excerpt: Adapts positively to changing circumstances and operational constraints while preserving delivery standards.

questions.question_text: What behavior distinguishes advanced personal mastery (Level 4/5) in public statistical service?

options.A: Treating existing competencies as complete and avoiding ongoing professional upskilling
options.B: Proactively pursuing continuous professional development, learning from setbacks, and modeling accountability for peers
options.C: Demanding non-merit exemptions from annual cadre capacity building requirements
options.D: Restricting professional knowledge sharing to close personal associates

questions.explanation: KCM Level 4/5 Personal Effectiveness highlights lifelong learning, self-reflection, and setting an exemplary benchmark of public service excellence.
questions.source_excerpt: Demonstrates self-directed learning and continuous professional growth, inspiring high ethical standards across the team.

questions.question_text: In official government statistics, how does 'Citizen Centricity' (KCM-FUNC-01) manifest in statistical dissemination?

options.A: Restricting all official survey reports behind commercial subscription paywalls
options.B: Ensuring transparent, accessible, and user-friendly dissemination of official data and indicator dashboards for public and policy use
options.C: Publishing data solely in raw hexadecimal formats unusable by ordinary researchers
options.D: Discouraging open data access to minimize citizen inquiries

questions.explanation: KCM Citizen Centricity (Pages 65-66) focuses on orienting public systems and data dissemination to meet citizens' needs with transparency and accessibility.
questions.source_excerpt: Places the needs of citizens and stakeholders at the center of service delivery and information dissemination.

questions.question_text: How should a statistical directorate respond when researchers and citizens report ambiguities in published survey metadata?

options.A: Issue explanatory guidance notes, enhance metadata documentation, and streamline data access interfaces
options.B: Revoke public access to all historical survey series
options.C: Ignore inquiries unless mandated by statutory court summons
options.D: Impose punitive licensing restrictions on public academic users

questions.explanation: KCM Citizen Centricity emphasizes responsive communication, feedback incorporation, and enhancing public trust in government statistics.
questions.source_excerpt: Actively solicits and responds constructively to citizen feedback to improve transparency and accessibility.

questions.question_text: At an executive level (Level 4/5), what strategic reform reflects genuine citizen-centric governance in the official statistical system?

options.A: Aligning data collection and dissemination pipelines with open standards, digital inclusion, and maximum public utility for all socio-economic strata
options.B: Prioritizing commercial enterprise data demands while eliminating grassroots rural indicators
options.C: Outsourcing statistical governance to non-transparent offshore proprietary entities
options.D: Treating public data dissemination as secondary to confidential ministerial briefings

questions.explanation: KCM Level 5 Citizen Centricity highlights systemic policy alignment that democratizes data access and ensures equitable public benefit.
questions.source_excerpt: Designs strategic service frameworks that ensure equitable, inclusive, and transparent outcomes for all segments of society.
